_comment: Hand-verified labels for PENDING calendar rows, applied to /calendar and every month page by fix_calendar_row_labels.py. Added 2026-11-21 (round-4 currency audit): month pages carried labels from an older generator, and Bing Copilot cites the month pages. Each label names the application the row's goal date belongs to, from the source given. Remove an entry when its row is decided.

labels.label: Bezuclastinib: Nonadvanced systemic mastocytosis (SUMMIT)
labels.why: Cogent 8-K, Aug 10 2026: NonAdvSM PDUFA December 30, 2026; GIST is the separate November 30 application.

labels.label: Povetacicept (ALPN-303): IgA nephropathy
labels.why: Vertex 8-K, Aug 3 2026: BLA for accelerated approval in IgAN, PDUFA November 30, 2026. Not lupus nephritis.

labels.label: Lorundrostat: Hypertension
labels.why: Mineralys Q3 release, Nov 4 2026: PDUFA target date December 22, 2026. The month page read 'lorundrostat Dose 1'.

labels.label: Relacorilant: Cushing's syndrome (hypercortisolism)
labels.why: Corcept release, Jul 29 2026: NDA for relacorilant in Cushing's syndrome resubmitted, PDUFA December 17, 2026. The row read 'Relacorilant - (GRACE resubmission)' with no indication.

labels.label: Anito-cel (anitocabtagene autoleucel): Relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma
labels.why: Gilead release, Feb 23 2026: BLA for anito-cel as fourth-line treatment of relapsed or refractory multiple myeloma, PDUFA action date December 23, 2026. The row gave no indication.
